data.gender_notes: Neena is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word 'neeti', meaning guidance or advice. Neena is a name of purity and simplicity, often given to girls who are believed to possess great wisdom and the ability to provide guidance. The name Neena carries the meaning “Pure, Simple” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Neena usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, simple and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Neena total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

The name Neena is a reflection of this tradition, representing the ideal of intelligence and knowledge.
